heading: Calendars
intro: Import a calendar to see busy time alongside your plan. Your calendar stays on this device.
noSources: No calendars yet. Import an .ics file or add a subscription.
noEvents: Create an event to add it to your preferred calendar.
title: Title
formInvalid: Enter a title, a day and a valid time.
size: This calendar exceeds the 5 MB limit.
frequency: Secondly and minutely recurrence rules are not supported.
timezone: This calendar uses an unknown time zone. Export it with a VTIMEZONE definition.
iterations: This calendar exceeds the 50,000-iteration limit for this range.
occurrences: This calendar exceeds the 5,000-event limit for this range.
invalid: This calendar could not be read. Choose a valid .ics file.
range: Choose an end after the start of the range.
interval: This calendar contains an event ending before it starts.
storage: Calendar storage is unavailable. Check browser storage permissions and try again.
save: Changes could not be saved. Your previous data has been retained.
missingFile: “{name}” is not saved here, so its events cannot be shown. Remove it and import its .ics file again.
missingUrl: “{name}” has not been downloaded here yet. Choose Refresh under it to download it again.
url: Enter an http, https or webcal URL without a username or password.
fetch: This feed could not be fetched (CORS or network error). Google, Outlook and iCloud private feeds usually block browser access. Use Import .ics file, or open Weeklid in companion mode and try again.
guestInvalid: Enter an email address, like name{'@'}example.com.
guestLimit: An event can have up to 50 guests.
guestsHint: Weeklid sends nothing. The guests are added when you open the event in Google Calendar or Outlook, or download its .ics.

googleConnection.title: Google Calendar
googleConnection.summary: Read-only access to your primary calendar. Events stay in this tab's memory.
googleConnection.readOnly: Weeklid will only read the events in your primary Google calendar, to show your busy time next to your plan. It never creates, changes or deletes events.
googleConnection.memoryOnly: Events stay only in this tab's memory: they aren't saved on the device and never go through a Weeklid server.
googleConnection.refreshHint: It updates while Weeklid is open and authorized; when you open it again or the permission expires (after about an hour), tap Update.
googleConnection.aiBusy: If you copy your plan for an AI, your Google meetings go as “Busy”, without a title.
googleConnection.testing: While the app is in testing, Google shows an unverified-app warning and may ask for permission again.
googleConnection.disconnectBody: Weeklid will forget your Google events in this tab and in any other open ones, and ask Google to withdraw its access.
googleConnection.notLoaded: Google Calendar isn't loaded: your tasks might land on top of meetings.
googleConnection.expiredLine: Google's permission expired: your events might be out of date.
googleConnection.loadedRange: Google Calendar is loaded from {start} to {end}.

messages.revokeConfirmed: Disconnected. Google confirmed it withdrew access.
messages.revokeUnconfirmed: Disconnected on this device. We couldn't confirm it with Google: check your account permissions.
messages.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked Google's window. Allow pop-ups for {host} and try again.
messages.accessDenied: Nothing was connected. You can connect whenever you like.
messages.missingScope: Weeklid needs permission to see your events. Connect again and leave that box checked.
messages.expired: Google's permission expired. Tap Reconnect to update your events.
messages.busy: Google is busy; try again in a few minutes.
messages.server: Google didn't respond properly ({status}). Try again later.
messages.network: Couldn't reach Google. Check your connection and try again.
messages.timeout: Google took too long to respond. Try again.
messages.tooMany: Your calendar has more than 2,000 events in these weeks, so nothing was updated.
messages.format: Google sent something Weeklid can't read, so nothing was updated.
messages.gisLoad: Couldn't load Google. Check your connection or your blockers.
